result.stdout:
Moaid Hathot / a little more than a business card.

moaid [options]

  --demo 1|2                    Choose Constellation / Prism (default: 2)
  --theme aurora|ember|glacier   Choose a palette (default: aurora)
  --once                        Print a finished card and exit
  --no-motion                   Keep interaction, stop all animation
  --plain                       Print a readable, unstyled profile
  --json                        Export the profile as JSON
  --ascii                       Use only ASCII characters
  --image auto|sixel|blocks      Native Sixel portrait when supported
  --cell-size WIDTHxHEIGHT      Override reported image cell pixels
  --about                       Open the extended profile
  --color auto|truecolor|256|16|none
  --tour                        Tour this demo's palettes (12 seconds)
  --demo                        Without a number: shorthand for --tour
  --duration SECONDS            Exit after a bounded preview
  --fps 1..60                    Animation frame cap (default: 60)
  --width 20..300 --height 8..120  Size an --once snapshot
  --version                     Print the package version
  -h, --help                    Show this help

Keys: D or Left/Right demo, T theme, A about, Space pause,
      G GitHub, W website, L LinkedIn, Tab/Shift+Tab select link,
      Enter open link, Up/Down scroll a small window, ? help, Q/Esc quit.

NO_COLOR and TERM=dumb produce plain text. NO_MOTION=1 or
REDUCE_MOTION=1 disables animation. Redirected output is plain by
default; an explicit --color enables a single ANSI snapshot.
Native images are used in live mode; snapshots and ASCII use blocks.
